sed -r '/signingConfigs.getByName/d' -i app/build.gradle.kts

find . -name '*.apk'

reproducible-apk-tools/zipalign.py --page-size 4 --pad-like-apksigner --replace app/build/outputs/apk/release/de1984-*-release.apk /outputs/unsigned.apk
